title: Knights Wish — claim guardians
purpose: Reviewed source paintings for deposit planning and real optional resource guardian combat. Three guardians have implemented encounters and paired wind-up paintings; the other three remain expansion concepts.
style: Detailed crisp pixel art; earthy materials, localized luminous minerals, three-quarter view, upper-left light, transparent source masters.

assets.name: Ironroot Colossus
assets.claim_concept: A sealed iron seam held by a living mining bulwark.
assets.future_combat_concept: A slow guardian that telegraphs heavy line-breaking slams.
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: source monster sprite for Knights Wish, a dark storybook fantasy dungeon and kingdom-building game. Create ONE polished full-body creature, not a sprite sheet. Style: premium detailed pixel art, visibly crisp square pixel clusters and stepped edges, a readable dark outline, handmade 16-bit fantasy feeling, no smooth painterly strokes, no 3D render. Muted earthy materials with small luminous accents. Three-quarter front view, consistent light from upper left. Strong silhouette readable at small game-icon size. Center the complete creature in a square image with generous transparent margins on every side; no cropped extremities. Truly transparent background, no floor, no scenery, no pedestal, no cast ground shadow, no border, no labels or text. Subject: Ironroot Colossus, an ancient squat hulking golem that has grown around an iron seam. Its body is dark slate boulders crossed by rust-red and bright steel ore bands, two great uneven hammer fists, powerful short legs, jagged iron shoulder plates. A tiny warm amber furnace-eye peers from a recessed square head. A few root-like iron tendrils connect stone joints. Wide powerful stance, one fist slightly raised, readable sturdy silhouette. No weapons held, no surrounding rocks, just the golem.

runtime.animation: Actual attack state selects rest or wind-up art; breathing, charge compression, leap rise and recovery are procedural.
